scripts.test: DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://rssify@localhost:54329/rssify_test} DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://rssify@localhost:54329/rssify_test} bunx prisma migrate deploy && DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://rssify@localhost:54329/rssify_test} DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://rssify@localhost:54329/rssify_test} bun test
